action_summary: Round 8 priced the negative: no demonstration teaches `median` while no operation fits its example answers -- the lesson was refused with reason NO_OPERATION_I_CAN_PERFORM_GIVES_THESE_ANSWERS and the prescription was to grow the operator space deliberately and pay for it in code. This round executes that prescription once and measures every step of the loop. Pre-registered predictions, all seven held: under the old algebra 0 of 400 operations fit the two-example median lesson; after one reducer is added in code the SAME lesson teaches exactly one word ({median: [median]}); five held-out requests nobody showed -- including a median-plus-rest composition and a file in no lesson -- are answered correctly against oracles written before the run (5/5, 0 wrong); the independent recomputation accepts an honest median claim and rejects the upper median (claimed=20 recomputed=30); `mode` is still refused by name; no seed word changes meaning; clearing the cache, the stored lexicon alone still answers. End to end through the live door with its own taught_program_recomputed gate: teach, ask, pass, answer=9. Cost of the action: parts 14 -> 15, operations 400 -> 560, two runtime files, ~10 lines. Provenance receipt re-run and re-pinned at 39/39 with producer-vs-checker 5600 comparisons and 0 disagreements. No capability registered, no benchmark row moved, no seed lesson or lexicon touched, no live state written into the tree.
explicit_user_authorization: Owner directive 2026-11-12: determine what is real about instant learning and advanced coding/computer-use actions, kill bad ideas before implementation, think from first principles, maximize use of the latest research, and always push and merge completed work. This change executes round 8's standing prescription -- grow the operator space deliberately and pay for it in code -- as one priced, pre-registered measurement. Zero spend, zero model dependency, no governance change, no sentience claim.
